17.11.2026 (РМЦ КЖ, Revit) user: «кжлардың спецификациясын менің шаблонымдай ет. Қазіргілерді өшір, ережені тексер, қателерін өшіріп таста».

**Why:** the tables Revit generated by default looked different from the user's template: the title sat inside the table, a blank row came before the data, «Материалы:» was one common section, numbers used a decimal comma, and some text was cut to «…».

**How to apply (every КЖ table, Revit or DWG):**
- **Title** sits outside the table: 3.5 mm text, 1.5 mm above the table.
- **Row heights:** header 15 mm, data 8 mm; M_07 scheme spec 6.5 mm; a two-line cell is 11 mm.
- **No blank row.** In Revit, build the whole table in the header section (static «header-only» table, empty body).
- **Spec rows follow M_10/M_20:**
  - element row with the total mass in Примечание;
  - its positions;
  - its own «Материалы:» section (M_20).
- **Concrete row:**
  - Поз. is empty;
  - «ГОСТ 7473-2010 (212-101-xxxx)» goes in Обозначение (see [[agsk-code-in-spec]]).
- **Numbers** use a decimal point with 2 decimals (template 86429.42). Volumes below 0.1 get 3 decimals.
- **ВРС header** is multi-level, as in M_10:
  - columns: Изделия арматурные → Арматура класса → А240/А500С → «ГОСТ 34028-2016 (3-part code)» → Ø… → Итого | Всего;
  - empty cells are «---».
- **No text may be cut off.** Minimum widths:
  - «Изделия арматурные» span ≥ 48 mm;
  - А500С group ≥ 52 mm with two codes, ≥ 30 mm with one;
  - long names wrap at «, »;
  - «Марка элемента» column is sized to the text.
- **Summary list (7.1, M_20):** Примечание = Кол. × Масса ед.
- **Ведомость деталей (X2/M_15):**
  - table «Поз. | Эскиз» 15 | 48 mm, header 12 mm, rows 20 mm; more than 4 positions → two groups side by side;
  - sketches drawn on the sheet in the X2 style, not Revit shape images: U «[» (long base → «⊔»), L «_|», hoop with crossed hooks at the top-right, pin;
  - numbers, «по н.г.» (U, L) / «по в.г.» (hoop, pin), «L=…»;
  - hoop numbers: bottom = width, left = height, top = width + C, right = height + C;
  - generator `kz99_vd.cs` (detail group «КЖ_ВД_<sheet>»).
- **Placement:** in free space, anchored to the title point so that re-runs don't move the table.
- **Before showing:**
  - inspect a 300 dpi PNG crop of every table;
  - check that sheet PNGs have the 1.414 aspect ratio (an object far off the sheet shrinks the whole page);
  - run the off-sheet element check.

Tools: `D:\_claude_work\RMC\kzh\kz94_tables.cs`, `kz97_static_tables.cs`. Obsidian: `18_КЖ жүйесі\10_Шаблоннан алынатын тұрақты блоктар` § «Revit-те кестелер шаблон пішінімен».
